summary: Fentress County, TN tower inside Pickett CCC Memorial State Park; a travel guide says the CCC built it in the 1930s; no design, date or fire history found.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only source that names this tower as CCC-built is a travel blog, which gives no year. The Tennessee Encyclopedia says the CCC built fire towers in Pickett County without naming this one. The official tnstateparks.com pages returned HTTP 403, and the park's Wikipedia article does not mention the tower. Build year, design, height, agency and fire history are unknown and were not added. Climbing status and condition need confirmation from the park before anyone climbs; the story says so. Record coordinates and 1,720 ft elevation agree with Wikidata and the tnlandforms list. Fact check 2026-10-09: the story calls the tnlandforms.us list a Tennessee lookout-tower list, not a state list, because the page does not say it is official, and gives 1,720 ft as elevation, matching its Elev. column.
